text.card: A red giant 4,658 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 1.42 solar masses and 10.8 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,803 K at its surface.
